items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kenny Burrell also teaches out there.

ctx.x: Isn’t he a psychologist? Doesn’t he have a PhD in something that’s not music?
I think you’re right. But, he teaches at some school out in San Diego. It might be UCSD I believe. Kenny Burrell also teaches out there.
Yeah, he was at UCLA, I believe.

items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I recorded with all of them, I’m so happy.

ctx.x: Right, man, unbelievable. And I recorded with all of them, I’m so happy.

So, again, looking at your career in New York, ‘cause we know you’re going to make that transition, so we want to get as much covered in New York. So you’ve already, now you’re a leader, you’re signed to labels, have you stopped doing the pit orchestra and things like that ‘cause you…Midnight Blue?
